The Supreme Court lifted an injunction across 23 states, permitting the administration to direct the Postal Service to check mail-in ballot delivery against DHS citizenship databases.

Presenting administrative voter screening as a purely internal federal directive conceals its direct physical impact on mail delivery in contested elections.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
A classic WHO versus WHAT inversion: framed as protecting public democratic integrity (WHO), but engineered to control the mechanics of ballot delivery (WHAT).

Social Physics Analysis:
By manufacturing claims of widespread non-citizen voting, the executive justifies unilateral administrative hurdles. Power is hoarded by projecting fraud onto standard mail-in systems to rationalize pre-midterm ballot screening.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
The significant gap between stated election security goals and real-world ballot filtering drives institutional trajectory toward Lesser Evil through administrative friction.

The Unavoidable Truth: Executive control over postal delivery alters election dynamics.
The Unavoidable Lie: Federal postal ballot filtering carries zero practical impact on state voters.
